brief:
Palestinian politician Sami Abu Shehadeh, who leads an Arab party, withdrew from Israel's upcoming elections, Al Jazeera English reported. The decision removes a significant Arab voice from the electoral contest.

Details of Abu Shehadeh's reasoning and the timing of his withdrawal were not immediately available. Arab parties have historically played a contested role in Israeli politics, with their participation and boycotts becoming recurring points of political debate.
dek: Palestinian politician Sami Abu Shehadeh withdrew from Israel’s upcoming election.
title: Palestinian politician withdraws from Israeli election race
